 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.9417 Of 2024
Order:

entities.text: Vummethala Ravi vs The Union Of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"......to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Certiorari by declaring the action of respondent No.3 in issuing the Letter Ref No.IMP/317561669/24 dated April 3, 2024 vide File No.HY3071444318518 impounding the passport of the petitioner as illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional by calling for records and set aside the Letter Ref No.IMP/317561669/24 dated Apr 3,
2024 vide File No.HY3071444318518 issued by respondent No.3 impounding the passport of the petitioner ......"

2. It is the case of the petitioner that his marriage was performed with one Naga Sharanya on 29.05.2019 as per the Hindu Rites and Customs and thereafter, when disputes arose between them,
he was constrained to file F.C.O.P No.856 of 2023 on the file of the Principal Family Court,
Hyderabad seeking dissolution of marriage and the same is pending.

It is the further case of the petitioner that said Naga Sharanya filed a false complaint against him and his family members on the file of Miyapur Police Station and after completion of investigation, charge sheet was filed and the same was taken cognizance as C.C.No.204 of 2023 on the file of the VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally for the offences under Sections 498A of IPC and Section 3 &
4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further case of the petitioner that he filed Crl.P.No.5256 of 2023 on the file of this Court seeking to quash the proceedings against him in C.C.No.204 of 2023 on the file of the VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally and the same was dismissed on 06.10.2023.

entities.text: VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further case of the petitioner that he is appearing regularly in the said C.C and contesting the matter.

While the things stood thus, respondent No.3 issued show cause notice vide HYD/30/POL/PCC/312/2023, dated 13.11.2023 to the petitioner calling for explanation regarding pending criminal case i.e., C.C.No.204 of 2023 against him on the file of the VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally along with necessary documentary proof within 21 days,
failing which necessary action would be initiated against him as per Section 10(3)(e) of the Passports Act, 1967.

entities.text: VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is further case of the petitioner that soon after receipt of the said show cause notice, he submitted his explanation on 03.12.2023 and without considering the same, respondent No.3 issued impugned letter, dated 03.04.2024 impounding the passport No.S5059922 of the petitioner.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that without considering the explanation, dated 03.12.2023 submitted by the petitioner to the show cause notice, dated 13.11.2023, respondent No.3 issued impugned letter, dated 03.04.2023, which action on the part of respondent No.3 amounts to gross violation of principles of natural justice and therefore, prayed this Court to set aside the impugned letter.

sentences.text:
On the other hand, Ms.Anjali Agarwal, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents vehemently contended that the explanation submitted by the petitioner has been considered by the respondent authorities and the same was intimated to the petitioner vide letter dated, 27.12.2023.
5.
A careful examination of the impugned letter, dated 03.04.2024 issued by the respondent No.3 does not reflect that the explanation, dated 03.12.2023 submitted by the petitioner has been considered.

As per the submissions of learned Standing Counsel for respondents, vide impugned letter dated 27.12.2023, respondent No.3 has received explanation submitted by the petitioner and the petitioner was directed to cooperate with the court proceedings by attending Court in person as and when required otherwise necessary action would be initiated against the passport of the petitioner as per the Rules.
6.
Having issued letter, dated 27.12.2023, respondent No.3 has not assigned any reasons that the petitioner has violated any conditions for impounding of the passport.
In view of the above circumstances, impugned letter, dated 03.04.2024 issued by respondent No.3 is liable to be set aside and accordingly, the same is set aside.
Respondent No.3 is directed to consider the explanation, dated 03.12.2023 submitted by the petitioner and assign valid reasons for impounding the passport of the petitioner.

Pending consideration of the same, the petitioner is directed to appear regularly in C.C.No.204 of 2023 on the file of the VIII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Kukatpally as and when his presence is required.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
